method: Each candidate pair (same vessel name and occurrence date within 3 days) was opened on both publishers and judged the same casualty event if vessel(s), date and place agree; IMO numbers were then compared where both report PDFs print them. Source: mai_measure.json.

pairs.note: Polesie / Verity collision in the German Bight; joint investigation led by MAIB for the Red Ensign Group. IMO 9229178 and 9488097 printed in both PDFs.

joins.rejected_name_pairs: The other 27 name pairs are occurrence dates years apart (different vessels sharing a word such as a common ship name); none is the same event.
